req.title: Session cookie has HttpOnly attribute
req.statement: The system shall set HttpOnly on the session cookie.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that the session cookie carries the HttpOnly attribute. Flask sets this via SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY (default True). We test: (1) positive – after a successful login the Set-Cookie header contains 'HttpOnly'; (2) negative – we verify the attribute is present as a discrete flag, not just any substring, catching mutations that remove it; (3) boundary/STC – we check the attribute survives across the full login→session→logout state cycle; (4) DT – we verify the attribute is present on the very first response that sets the cookie (POST /auth/login), not only on subsequent requests; (5) BVA – we inspect the raw header value to confirm 'HttpOnly' appears exactly once and is not confused with a partial match.

tests.name: test_session_cookie_has_httponly_after_login
actions: Inspect Set-Cookie header of the response
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_session_cookie_has_httponly_after_login():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert set_cookie != '', 'Set-Cookie header must be present'
    assert 'HttpOnly' in set_cookie, f'HttpOnly not found in: {set_cookie}'

test_session_cookie_has_httponly_after_login()

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_survives_state_transition
actions: Verify HttpOnly on logout Set-Cookie if present
expected: Login response HTTP 302 with HttpOnly in Set-Cookie
Logout response HTTP 302; if Set-Cookie present it also has HttpOnly
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_session_cookie_httponly_survives_state_transition():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r_login = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Ishaan', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r_login.status_code == 302
    login_cookie = r_login.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert login_cookie != '', 'Set-Cookie must be present on login'
    assert 'HttpOnly' in login_cookie, f'HttpOnly missing on login: {login_cookie}'
    r_logout = client.get('/auth/logout')
    assert r_logout.status_code == 302
    logout_cookie = r_logout.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    if logout_cookie:
        assert 'HttpOnly' in logout_cookie, f'HttpOnly missing on logout: {logout_cookie}'

test_session_cookie_httponly_survives_state_transition()

actions: Confirm the very first Set-Cookie response carries HttpOnly

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_session_cookie_httponly_present_on_first_set_cookie_response():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Diya', 'password': 'cloud'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie_header = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert set_cookie_header != '', 'Expected Set-Cookie header to be non-empty'

    )

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_not_set_on_failed_login
actions: Verify no session cookie is set (no successful session created)
expected: No Set-Cookie header with a session value, OR if present it does not create an authenticated session
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_session_cookie_httponly_not_set_on_failed_login():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'WRONG'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Incorrect password.' in r.data
    r2 = client.get('/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200

test_session_cookie_httponly_not_set_on_failed_login()

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_attribute_value_exact
actions: Assert 'HttpOnly' directive exists and 'Secure' is absent (HTTP test client)
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_session_cookie_httponly_attribute_value_exact():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert set_cookie != ''
    parts = [p.strip() for p in set_cookie.split(';')]
    cookie_name = parts[0].split('=')[0].strip()
    assert cookie_name == 'session', f'Expected cookie name "session", got "{cookie_name}"'
    httponly_count = sum(1 for p in parts if p.lower() == 'httponly')
    assert httponly_count == 1, (
        f'Expected exactly 1 HttpOnly directive, found {httponly_count} in: {set_cookie}'
    )

test_session_cookie_httponly_attribute_value_exact()
